description: This file is a Perl script named 'version-check.pl' used to check versions of symbols used in a provided source file, specifically related to the curl project. It reads a symbols-in-versions document, scans the source file for symbols starting with 'CURL', and reports the most recent version of curl in which these symbols appear.

methods.name: age
methods.description: Converts a version string into a numerical value for comparison.

methods.name: sortversions
methods.description: Comparator function to sort symbols based on their version introduction date.
